purpose: The single contract every microtask-authoring agent follows, so that 1,487 new contracts and 509 patches written by different agents in parallel come out as one coherent set rather than fifteen dialects.

what_is_being_replaced.current_state: mt-author.py generated 1,487 structurally-correct but GENERIC contracts, one per capability cluster. Each has the right shape (multi-row acceptance criteria with stable ids and evidence kinds, one proof target per row, resource privacy obligation, validator focus, implementation notes, corrected diagnostic tiers) but its content is templated from the cluster name.
what_is_being_replaced.what_agents_must_do: Replace the generic content with real behavioural specification drawn from the green-room captures. The generated file is the skeleton and the starting point, never the deliverable.
what_is_being_replaced.the_test: A capable model with no chat context, reading only the microtask, must be able to implement the behaviour without guessing a range, a default, an enumerated value, a unit, or what the feature does. If it would have to guess, the microtask is not finished.

hard_rules_from_operator_decisions: SAD-001. Every code_surfaces path resolves against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree at ../wtc-native-editors-v1. Never main. Reconcile against the real tree; do not invent paths.

SAD-002. No microtask may introduce SQLite, libSQL, Turso, PostgreSQL, or any second database. SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. It runs embedded via kv-rocksdb; there is no database process to start.
SAD-003. No microtask may add routing machinery. Navigation extends loom_address.rs, navigation_bus.rs and the existing ShellNavigator seams.

SAD-004. handshake_core must never gain wgpu, WGSL or GPU dependencies; all GPU and compute work lives in the studio-engine crate behind the six Send + Sync traits. Text shaping must be native Rust of the cosmic-text / rustybuzz / swash class; a platform text engine is forbidden even where it would be easier.
SAD-006. Do not propose a consolidation that only works given an unbuilt capability. If a merge needs simultaneous visibility of two members, un-merge it.

SAD-007. Video is fully in scope, timeline clip editing and compositing both, for professional editors and VFX artists. Do not treat any Premiere or After Effects capability as out of scope on the strength of [STU-OVR-015]; that clause is superseded and flagged for amendment.
SAD-008. Spec anchors are PROVISIONAL until the Master Spec update lands. Keep spec_anchor_status as it is; do not invent anchor ids. The spec update assigns the real ones.

GRD-001. The capability registry merged rows on name alone until it was fixed. Do not cite the pre-fix sharing counts. If a capability's app_count looks surprising, check the evidence field before relying on it.

where_the_behaviour_comes_from.rule: Every parameter, range, default, unit and enumerated value in a microtask must be traceable to a named capture file. Do not write a range you cannot cite.

the_parameter_contract.why_this_matters_most: This is the single most consequential detail in the whole green room. After Effects declares a valid range and a slider range separately on 833 parameters, and on 61.2 percent of the 618 that declare both, they DIFFER. Blend is valid from 5 to 10000 but its slider runs 10 to 500. Premiere's Lumetri carries the same split as hard bounds and UI bounds.
required_fields: hard_min and hard_max: the values the engine will actually accept. Exceeding these is an error.
soft_min and soft_max: the range the control presents by default. A user may type past these but not past the hard bounds.
unit: the real unit token from the capture (pixels, percent, degrees, seconds, document units), not a guess
precision: decimal places as the source declares them
step and coarse_step and fine_step for the scrubbable control
the_parameter_contract.irreversible_mistake: Collapsing hard and soft bounds into one range. Do it once and the distinction cannot be recovered without re-deriving it from the captures. Emit both fields from the first contract even when a source declares only one, marking the other as absent rather than equal.
the_parameter_contract.where_bounds_are_absent: Photoshop leaves 79.7 percent of numeric properties unbounded and Premiere carries bounds on only 6.4 percent of 9,654 rows. Affinity's are OBSERVED across shipped presets, not declared, so clamping to them would forbid legal values. Where a bound is unknown, say so explicitly in the contract; never invent one and never clamp to an observed range as though it were declared.

every_microtask_must_carry: A clause naming one coherent behaviour, not a cluster label.
A scope summary a no-context implementer can act on, including what the feature does and what it produces.
Multiple acceptance criteria, each with a stable id, an evidence_kind, and a source_evidence field citing the capture file it came from.
One proof target per acceptance row, naming a real command or check.
code_surfaces reconciled against the 012 tree, with code_surface_status stating whether each path exists or is proposed.
implementation_notes carrying the actual extracted behaviour: parameters with the full contract above, enumerated values, defaults, and the vendor's own description where one was recovered.
gui_obligation with the surface and stable author_id targets.
user_manual_obligation naming the target entry and what it must cover.
validator_focus that names what a reviewer should attack, specific to this behaviour.
risk_if_missed stated as what a professional loses.
hbr_int_009_tier_obligations with all three tiers WIRED against the 012 base.

naming_discipline.rule: [STU-SECTION-003]. A source product name is never a Studio tool, command, panel, or manual name. Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Affinity, Photo, Designer, Publisher, Figma, FigJam, Premiere, After Effects, Lightroom and Dreamweaver appear only as provenance in evidence fields.
naming_discipline.dedup: Where several applications provide a capability, it collapses to ONE Studio operation with per-suite variants recorded as provenance. Do not author one microtask per source application for the same behaviour.

patching_the_existing_509.defects_measured: 463 of 509 have exactly one acceptance row; 401 of those jam several criteria into one semicolon string. All 509 have exactly one proof target. Zero carry a resource privacy obligation, validator focus, or implementation notes. 1,002 diagnostic tier obligations carry a stale reason claiming internal diagnostics and the external watcher ship later, when both exist in the 012 base.
patching_the_existing_509.task: Split the jammed rows into real criteria, attach a proof target to each, add the three missing field groups, correct the tier reasons, and attach the behavioural payload from the captures where the microtask's subject appears in them.
patching_the_existing_509.preserve: Do not discard the original clause or intent. These were authored against the spec and carry real scope decisions. Patch, do not rewrite.

output_discipline: JSON only. Never create a .md file.
Write to the staging directories under fold_back. Nothing under .GOV/task_packets is modified by an authoring agent.
Label every heuristic as heuristic. Where a capture failed or a value is unknown, say so in the contract rather than filling the gap.
Never report a file count as an entry count.
